docs.purpose: Lets an admin look up one user's full account record and activity, and make account-level changes to it: change which trades they're assigned, change their account tier, extend a free trial, revoke or suspend access, or permanently delete the account including cancelling their billing and scrubbing their personal data.
docs.data_story: It reads 4 tables — `user_profiles`, `entitlements`, `lead_views` and `lead_view_events` and writes `user_profiles`, `entitlements` and `admin_audit_log`. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 20 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 1 place: `src/features/admin-users/api/useAdminUsers.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: GET is read-only but still writes an admin_audit_log row when viewing a soft-deleted account, so it is not side-effect free. PATCH is a discriminated union of six actions (set_trades, set_preset, extend_trial, revoke, suspend, delete); each case is wrapped in one transaction with its writeAdminAudit call, so a mutation cannot commit without its audit row. delete additionally makes two external calls outside the transaction (Supabase auth.admin.deleteUser and cancelAllStripeSubscriptions), both best-effort with a stripe_cancel_failed_at marker on Stripe failure. Guards: cannot target an admin, cannot self-target a destructive action, admin_key auth cannot mutate. Called via a template literal from src/features/admin-users/api/useAdminUsers.ts. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: EXTERNAL SERVICE CALLS (delete action only): Supabase auth.admin.deleteUser at :332 (client from src/lib/supabase/admin.ts:23); Stripe cancelAllStripeSubscriptions at :347 -> stripe.subscriptions.list (src/lib/stripe/client.ts:154) + stripe.subscriptions.update{cancel_at_period_end:true} (src/lib/stripe/client.ts:159). PostHog POST at src/lib/admin/analytics.ts:115 (awaited at route :214). BOTH Stripe and Supabase failures are swallowed (:333, :349) — a delete can report 200 with the auth user still live. NOTE also that StripeNotConfiguredError is NOT specially handled here (unlike reconcile/retry-cancel): a missing STRIPE_SECRET_KEY throws inside getStripeClient (src/lib/stripe/client.ts:25), is caught by the generic catch at :347 and silently sets stripeCancelFailed=true, so an unconfigured env is recorded as Stripe debt rather than surfaced. CENSUS CHECK: census_reads [user_profiles, entitlements, lead_views, lead_view_events] and census_writes [user_profiles, entitlements, admin_audit_log] all confirmed; census MISSED the `profiles` read (verify-admin.ts:117-120 and :198-201), the admin_audit_log UPDATE via scrub_admin_audit_for_target (:385 -> migrations/223_scrub_admin_audit_reason.sql:20-22), and admin_backup_codes (MFA-gated). No SELECT *. All SQL parameterised; DETAIL_SELECT_SQL is built by string concat (:85-89) but only from the compile-time DETAIL_BASE_COLUMNS literal array. GAP: unlike the sibling subscription routes, this route never checks isUuid(targetUid) before a PATCH — on a non-UUID legacy/dev uid every entitlements helper silently no-ops (src/lib/entitlements/index.ts:221, :244, :266) and returns 0, yet extend_trial/revoke/suspend/delete still return 200 with meta.audited:true and write an audit row claiming the new status. Also: the applyMutation switch (:232-387) has no default arm and returns undefined for an unmatched action; today it is exhaustive over the Zod union, so the branch is unreachable. | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control/revalidate/dynamic export anywhere in the file | Other guards / classification: PATCH refuses authMethod==='admin_key' at :147-155 (403). Self-target on DESTRUCTIVE_ACTIONS (revoke/suspend/delete, user-management-schemas.ts:118-122) refused at :191-193 (403). Target-is-admin refused for ALL actions at :200-206 via isProfileAdmin (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:196). CSRF Origin allowlist for PATCH at src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:70-78. MFA gate INERT unless ADMIN_MFA_ENFORCED at src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:143. | Locking tests: src/tests/admin-users.infra.test.ts.
